name: Update Mobile Number
goal: User requests to update their mobile number via Hinglish.
constraints: Bot must validate new mobile number format and confirm update.

phases.description: User says 'Mera mobile number update karna hai'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for new mobile number.
Bot confirms the new number and asks for confirmation.
Bot confirms mobile number updated successfully.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
